meta.description: Manual-confirmed label overrides for cockpit partner table normalization. Partner document used slightly different names than the live Sage catalog.
meta.usage: Entries map partner labels (as written in cockpit_partner_table_labels_v1.json) to confirmed live catalog table names. Applied once after loading labels.
meta.rationale: Verification against live Sage catalog (via list_tables MCP endpoint on 2026-03-25) revealed 5 naming mismatches between partner document and live catalog. All are abbreviation/prefix/casing differences, not semantic disagreements.

overrides.reason: Missing VK (Verkauf) prefix in partner document
Missing Fa (Fertigungsauftrag) qualifier. Live catalog uses 'Fa' (not 'FA').
Table name abbreviated in partner doc. Actual table includes 'Bde' (Betriebsdatenerfassung) qualifier. No 'KHKPpsStempel' exists in live catalog; confirmed via list_tables.
